text: Bitcoin's 2.6% decline outpaces Ethereum's 1.6% drop, signaling a shift toward risk-off positioning where traders are rotating out of larger-cap assets faster than smaller ones. The Fear & Greed index at 30 with a 20-point weekly deterioration reflects genuine market anxiety, though $125B in daily volume suggests participants are still engaged rather than frozen. Bitcoin's dominance climbing to 59.1% confirms the flight-to-safety pattern, with capital flowing toward the largest and most established asset as confidence in altcoins erodes.
